title: Phosphorus-based ligand effects on the structure and radical scavenging ability of molecular nanoparticles of CeO2

synthesis.procedure: Under aerobic conditions, PhPO3H2 (0.079 g, 0.50 mmol) and tBuCO2H (0.10 g, 1.0 mmol) were dissolved in stirred pyridine/MeOH (10:1 mL), then (NH4)2[Ce(NO3)6] (0.55 g, 1.0 mmol) was added. After stirring 30 min, the yellow solution was layered with EtOH (20 mL) and left undisturbed for 5 days at ambient temperature, giving yellow block crystals of 1·xEtOH. Crystals for X-ray were kept in mother liquor; otherwise they were filtered, washed with EtOH, and dried under vacuum.
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: layered with EtOH (20 mL); yellow blocks of 1·xEtOH; filtered, washed with EtOH, dried under vacuum

synthesis.procedure: Under aerobic conditions, Ph2PO2H (0.11 g, 0.50 mmol) and tBuCO2H (0.10 g, 1.0 mmol) were dissolved in stirred pyridine/MeOH (10:1 mL), then (NH4)2[Ce(NO3)6] (0.55 g, 1.0 mmol) was added. After stirring 30 min, the yellow solution was layered with MeCN (20 mL) and left undisturbed for 5 days at ambient temperature, giving yellow triangular prisms of 2·2py·2H2O. Crystals for X-ray were kept in mother liquor; otherwise they were filtered, washed with MeCN, and dried under vacuum.

synthesis.procedure: Ce(NO3)3 (0.22 g, 0.50 mmol) was dissolved with stirring in MeCN (15 mL), then tBuCO2H (0.12 g, 1.2 mmol) and pyridine (360 μL, 4.4 mmol) were added. After stirring 1 h, (NH4)2[Ce(NO3)6] (0.055 g, 0.10 mmol) was added to the colorless solution. The yellow solution was stirred another hour and left undisturbed at ambient temperature for 14 days, giving small gold crystals. Identity as previously reported [Ce6O4(OH)4(O2C^tBu)12] was confirmed by unit-cell and FT-IR comparison; no new CCDC deposition is given in this paper.
synthesis.time: stirred 1 h then 1 h; 14 days crystallization
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: left undisturbed 14 days; small gold crystals
